events.title: NOMAD: The Legend of Zarqa | Demo is LIVE!
events.summary: Today, the public demo for NOMAD: The Legend of Zarqa is live on Steam!Join Our Discord Oasis Here.When we started Ash Games Studio, many of you knew us from Azooma Escape, a lighthearted stealth-comedy about dodging family hospitality. Moving from that into a dark, kinetic action-roguelite was a massive creative leap, but we were driven by a single goal: to bring a severely overlooked, breathtaking mythos from the Arabian Peninsula to life. events.title: The Public Playtest for Nomad Has Begun
events.summary: For the past several months, Nomad: The Legend of Zarqa has lived quietly behind closed doors.A dedicated group of playtesters has explored the Peninsula through prototype after prototype, helping us shape combat, progression, exploration, and the overall feel of the journey on our dedicated Discord Channel. events.title: The Vision Behind Nomad: Mapping Out the Oasis
events.summary: Until now, Project Nomad has lived in fragments... glimpses of combat, atmosphere, and mechanics that hinted at something larger.Today, we open the scroll entirely.Here is the full vision: the direction, the themes, and the loop that ties Zarqa's journey together.The Desert Loop: Explore, Fall, RememberNomad combines roguelite stakes with the freedom of non-linear exploration.
